phase_1.title: Phase 1 · Merkava 4M Firing Solenoid & Primer Ignition
phase_1.description: Closing the crew firing circuit energizes the breech firing pin, igniting the primary propellant charge inside the sealed 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) chamber.

phase_2.title: Phase 2 · 680 MPa Chamber Deflagration
phase_2.description: Rapid propellant burn drives chamber pressure to 680 MPa against the heavy locked breechblock while accelerating the heavy projectile.

phase_3.title: Phase 3 · 5280 mm Ordnance Acceleration
phase_3.description: Expanding gases accelerate the 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) round along the 5280 mm barrel up to 1680 m/s (12,100,000 J).

phase_4.title: Phase 4 · Bore Clearance & Muzzle Blast
phase_4.description: The projectile clears the muzzle crown cleanly for engagements out to 4000 m while bore gases evacuate safely away from the crew.

phase_5.title: Phase 5 · Hydropneumatic Recoil Absorption
phase_5.description: Recoil cylinders absorb 28900 N-s of impulse smoothly across the cradle while transferring residual load into the chassis.

phase_6.title: Phase 6 · Breech Opening & Stub Extraction
phase_6.description: During battery runout, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech, ejecting the spent base stub cleanly into the deflector bin.

phase_7.title: Phase 7 · Munition Ramming & Battery Lock
phase_7.description: The next 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) round seats into the chamber and locks the breechblock back into firing readiness.

zh.headline: 以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克：2004 年机械传奇与工程剖析
zh.deck: 以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M 将 1,500 马力 V12 动力包前置在车体首下之后作为额外装甲护盾，留出车尾宽大双开逃生舱门；楔形模块化顶甲与“战利品”（Trophy）主动防护雷达拦截弹共同构成纵深生存体系。 本馆以 1:1 真实工程比例重现其 20 大核心构件与完整工作循环。

acts.title: 时代召唤与研发立项：Merkava 4M 的诞生背景
paragraphs: 2004 年问世的 以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克 由以色列以色列坦克管理局（MANTAK）主导研制，定位为经典的前置动力乘员防护主战坦克（1:1 真实尺度）。梅卡瓦（希伯来语意为“战车”）由以色列装甲兵之父塔尔将军主导研发，2011 年 Mk 4M 搭载的 Trophy 主动防御系统完成了现代坦克史上首次实战硬杀伤拦截。
以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M 将 1,500 马力 V12 动力包前置在车体首下之后作为额外装甲护盾，留出车尾宽大双开逃生舱门；楔形模块化顶甲与“战利品”（Trophy）主动防护雷达拦截弹共同构成纵深生存体系。 整件装备总长 9,040 mm（含炮管向前 · 车体 7,600 mm）、空重 65000 kg，成为同期重装坦克领域最具辨识度的里程碑之一。
acts.audioScript: 第一幕，时代起源。2004 年，以色列以色列坦克管理局（MANTAK）推出了划时代的以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克。梅卡瓦（希伯来语意为“战车”）由以色列装甲兵之父塔尔将军主导研发，2011 年 Mk 4M 搭载的 Trophy 主动防御系统完成了现代坦克史上首次实战硬杀伤拦截。 它的核心设计聚焦于标志性前置 GD883 1,500 马力柴油动力舱，化动力总成为首前附加护盾，奠定了其在重装坦克发展史中的经典地位。

acts.title: 核心机械构造与闭锁奥秘
paragraphs: 以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克 的机械灵魂在于其「10 发电动转鼓待发弹仓 + 半自动立楔炮闩 · 前置动力舱布局」结构体系。在发射工作循环中，主炮发射后液压驻退复进机吸收巨额炮膛后坐并自动开闩抛壳待装，将高压能量精确约束于承力框架之内。
制造工艺方面，关键承力件采用沙漠 CARC 抗化学涂层复合装甲钢精加工而成。后置双开装甲舱门可供乘员安全撤离、补弹或搭载担架伤员，在严苛实战条件下依然保持顺畅节拍与长期尺寸稳定性。
acts.audioScript: 第二幕，核心机械原理。以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克 采用10 发电动转鼓待发弹仓 + 半自动立楔炮闩 · 前置动力舱布局。在每个击发周期中，主炮发射后液压驻退复进机吸收巨额炮膛后坐并自动开闩抛壳待装。借助沙漠 CARC 抗化学涂层复合装甲钢工艺与高强度配合，实现了后置双开装甲舱门可供乘员安全撤离、补弹或搭载担架伤员。
acts.focusPartLabel: 重型立楔/螺式主炮炮闩

acts.title: 弹道性能、内膛工艺与实战效能
paragraphs: 该平台配用 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) 弹药规格与 5,280 mm（120mm L/44 高压镀铬滑膛炮 · 耐高压热护套），最高工作膛压约 680 MPa，可赋予弹头 1680 m/s 的出膛初速与 12,100,000 J 动能，有效作用距离达 4000 米。
内膛技术特点方面，MG253 120mm L/44 高压滑膛身管，支持发射 M338 穿甲弹与拉哈特炮射导弹。同时，10 发电动防火旋转待发弹鼓配合半自动立楔炮闩自动选弹，令其在 8 发/分（电动选弹鼓辅助） 的节奏下兼具精准控制与可靠输出。
acts.audioScript: 第三幕，弹道与实战表现。配备 5280 毫米身管与 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) 口径，以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克 实现了每秒 1680 米的初速与 4000 米有效射程。MG253 120mm L/44 高压滑膛身管，支持发射 M338 穿甲弹与拉哈特炮射导弹，展现了卓越的工程平衡。

acts.title: 人机工效、供弹哲学与百年遗产
paragraphs: 围绕 48 发容量的尾舱隔爆泄压主炮弹药架与 1920 mm 膛轴设计，以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克 将单发后坐冲量控制在 28900 N·s 水平。全球首个实战拦截反坦克导弹的“战利品”Trophy 主动防护系统。

acts.audioScript: 第四幕，百年遗产。凭借 48 发容量的尾舱隔爆泄压主炮弹药架与出色的整体工效，全球首个实战拦截反坦克导弹的“战利品”Trophy 主动防护系统。欢迎在 BAY-96 展位亲手切开剖面、逐件拆解，感受 以色列梅卡瓦 Mk 4M “风衣” 1:1 主战坦克 的机械魅力。

acts.title: Origins & Operational Mandate of the Merkava 4M
paragraphs: Introduced in 2004 by MANTAK (Israeli Tank Administration) in Israel, the Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker MBT emerged as a defining Front-Engine Main Battle Tank (1:1 Scale). Conceived by Major General Israel Tal with crew survival above all else, the Mk 4M Windbreaker achieved modern armor history’s first combat hard-kill missile interception with Trophy in 2011.

Designed around crew survivability first, the Merkava Mk 4M mounts its 1,500 hp V12 powerpack up front as an extra ballistic buffer, opening a rear hull hatch while pairing razor-sloped modular turret armor with the Trophy hard-kill active protection system. Measuring 9,040 mm (gun forward · 7,600 mm hull) at an unloaded weight of 65000 kg, it reshaped expectations across the 1:1 Main Battle Tank class.
acts.audioScript: Act One: Historical Origins. In 2004, MANTAK (Israeli Tank Administration) of Israel introduced the Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker MBT. Conceived by Major General Israel Tal with crew survival above all else, the Mk 4M Windbreaker achieved modern armor history’s first combat hard-kill missile interception with Trophy in 2011. Anchored by its hallmark design trait — Front-mounted GD883 1,500 hp V12 diesel acts as an extra frontal crew shield — it quickly established an enduring engineering benchmark.

acts.title: Core Operating Architecture & Lockup Mechanics
paragraphs: At the mechanical heart of the Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker MBT sits its 10-Round Electric Revolving Ready-Rack + Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech · Front Powerpack. Throughout every firing cycle, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech, containing 680 MPa of operating pressure safely.

Constructed in desert CARC chemical-resistant composite armor steel, the assembly achieves durable field tolerances. Notably, Rear armored hull doors permit protected crew egress, resupply, or medevac, sustaining dependable operation under severe environmental stress.
acts.audioScript: Act Two: Core Mechanical Architecture. The Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker MBT relies on 10-Round Electric Revolving Ready-Rack + Vertical Sliding-Wedge Breech · Front Powerpack. During each cycle, hydropneumatic recoil cylinders damp main-gun impulse and semi-automatically open the sliding breech. Machined from desert CARC chemical-resistant composite armor steel, it delivers standout engineering reliability: Rear armored hull doors permit protected crew egress, resupply, or medevac.

acts.title: Ballistic Performance, Bore Craft & Range Reach
paragraphs: Chambered for 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) with 5,280 mm (120mm L/44 High-Pressure Chrome Smoothbore), the Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker MBT develops 1680 m/s muzzle velocity and 12,100,000 J of kinetic energy for effective engagement out to 4000 meters.

Internally, MG253 120mm L/44 high-pressure smoothbore firing M338 APFSDS and LAHAT gun-launched missiles. Combined with its 8 RPM (electric ready-drum assist) tempo, 10-round fireproof electric revolving ready-drum feeds the MG253 120mm breech, delivering disciplined accuracy across demanding field conditions.
acts.audioScript: Act Three: Ballistic Performance. Driving 120mm MG253 L/44 Smoothbore (M338 APFSDS) through its 5280 millimeter bore, the Merkava Mk 4M Windbreaker MBT achieves 1680 meters per second and 4000 meters of effective reach. MG253 120mm L/44 high-pressure smoothbore firing M338 APFSDS and LAHAT gun-launched missiles.
